reusable_elements: a diversity claim
prohibited_generalizations: do not claim the angles cover everything

units.rhetorical_move: praises the attention to the groups affected

original_instantiations: Each part takes full account of the groups affected.
Each part takes full account of the crews affected.

units.source_excerpt: Each model analysis fully accounts for impacts on different stakeholders
units.reusable_pattern: X fully accounts for Y.
reusable_elements: an accounting claim
prohibited_generalizations: do not claim a group the paper skips

units.rhetorical_move: admits the assumptions stray

original_instantiations: Some assumptions stray from the real situation.
Some assumptions stray from the real roster.

units.source_excerpt: Some assumptions deviate from the real situation
units.reusable_pattern: Some X deviate from Y.
reusable_elements: an admission with some, not all
prohibited_generalizations: do not soften the admission

units.rhetorical_move: says what the stray assumptions cost

original_instantiations: These assumptions can give a poor picture and weaken the analysis.
These assumptions can give a poor picture and weaken the roster.

units.source_excerpt: These assumptions can lead to inaccurate reflection and undermine analysis reliability
units.reusable_pattern: X can lead to Y and undermine Z.
reusable_elements: a paired cost
prohibited_generalizations: do not say the analysis fails

units.rhetorical_move: admits a factor was left out

original_instantiations: Despite weighing several factors, the treatment of some is thin.
Despite weighing several constraints, the treatment of some is thin.

units.source_excerpt: Despite considering multiple factors, the study of some complex elements is incomplete
units.reusable_pattern: Despite X, Y is incomplete.
reusable_elements: a despite concession naming the gap
prohibited_generalizations: do not name a gap the paper does not own

units.rhetorical_move: says the first model does its job

original_instantiations: The network model reads the effect of the closure on the system and on the groups.
The roster model reads the effect of the cut on the system and on the crews.

units.source_excerpt: effectively analyzes the impact of the collapse on the local transportation system and stakeholders
units.reusable_pattern: X analyzes the impact of Y on Z.
reusable_elements: a verb of analyzing with two objects
prohibited_generalizations: do not claim a forecast

units.rhetorical_move: says what the model offers

original_instantiations: It shows the changes and offers a base for the response.
It shows the changes and offers a base for the remedy.

units.source_excerpt: It illustrates traffic flow changes and offers a basis for targeted countermeasures
units.reusable_pattern: It illustrates X and offers a basis for Y.
reusable_elements: an illustrates-and-offers pair
prohibited_generalizations: do not call the basis a proof

units.rhetorical_move: grants the flaws and then the use

original_instantiations: Despite its flaws, it guides the improvement of the network.
Despite its flaws, it guides the improvement of the roster.

units.source_excerpt: Despite the research's flaws, it guides the improvement of the local transportation network
units.reusable_pattern: Despite X, it guides Y.
reusable_elements: a despite close that keeps the claim modest
prohibited_generalizations: do not drop the flaws at the close

units.rhetorical_move: points the next work at the admitted gaps

original_instantiations: Future work could tighten the assumptions and weigh the harder factors.
Future work could tighten the assumptions and weigh the harder constraints.

units.source_excerpt: Future research could refine model assumptions and comprehensively consider complex factors
units.reusable_pattern: Future research could X and Y.
reusable_elements: a future-work sentence tied to the stated gaps
prohibited_generalizations: do not promise the refinement

units.rhetorical_move: opens the letter with a courtesy and a count

prohibited_generalizations: do not change the count

units.rhetorical_move: names the benefit and then the cost

The gain is a shorter queue. The cost is disruption and money.

units.reusable_pattern: Thank you for X, and we look forward to Y.
